prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic spontaneous bedroom lifestyle portrait in warm morning light, preserving the oversized linen shirt, bed setting and playful wink.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with dirty-blonde hair in a soft messy high bun and loose face-framing strands, blue-grey eyes, natural skin texture and a joyful wink with tongue slightly out. She wears an oversized cream linen button-down shirt with visible weave, wrinkles and relaxed loungewear fit.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level close-to-medium over-the-shoulder portrait on a white bed. The adult woman sits with her torso turned back toward camera, hands resting on a plush pillow, and keeps a spontaneous playful expression. Include white sheets, plush duvet, wooden nightstand, neutral wall and bedside lamp softly blurred behind her.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft directional warm morning light creates gentle highlights on hair, face and linen texture with relaxed bedroom shadows. Keep the feeling candid, energetic, friendly and homey.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical 4:5 or 2:3 smartphone portrait, 35mm natural perspective, f/2.8 shallow background, sharp eyes and shirt weave, realistic hair strands, warm airy color and raw-photo feel.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-photorealistic spontaneous bedroom lifestyle portrait in warm morning light of one original approved adult woman with dirty-blonde hair in a soft messy high bun and loose face-framing strands, blue-grey eyes, natural skin texture and a joyful wink with tongue slightly out. She wears an oversized cream linen button-down shirt with visible weave, wrinkles and relaxed loungewear fit. Use an eye-level close-to-medium over-the-shoulder portrait on a white bed; she sits with her torso turned back toward camera and hands resting on a plush pillow. Include white sheets, plush duvet, wooden nightstand, neutral wall and bedside lamp softly blurred behind her. Use soft directional morning light, realistic hair and linen detail, f/2.8 background falloff, warm airy color and candid raw-photo texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, child, teen, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted anatomy, wardrobe malfunction, invented logos, unreadable text
